subject: You beat the Queen!
body:
You beat the Queen!! You went all the way down there and came back. That's more dangerous than anything I've ever done, and I built a cloning machine.

She should have dropped an egg too. Put it down and it'll hatch into a Princess bonded to whoever placed it. Same as the Prince, golden apples help it grow.

Your old friend,
Dr. T
